bull_case_summary: Oracle has operating-income growth, 4.71x interest coverage and stated debt declining to $125.337bn. Round two uses this current progress to preserve a high-risk conversion scenario without presenting RPO, prepayments or equity funding as free owner cash.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts servicing capacity but retains negative $5.396bn FCF, $88.260bn net debt excluding leases and $19.909bn equity proceeds. $288bn nominal uncommenced leases are future commitments rather than current debt, and the low forward multiple does not erase funding dependence.
key_points_of_agreement: Existing IaaS and margin improvement demonstrate operating capability.
Prepayments are not unencumbered recurring cash.
Future nominal leases must not be mechanically added to current debt.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether current operating/debt progress and 13.16x forecast earnings sufficiently compensate external funding and dilution.
unresolved_uncertainties: Capacity delivery producing cash beyond funding costs.
Sustainable funding and diluted owner returns under future commitments.
